news.why: Contested, alarm-prone self-reported company evaluation. Reader questions (what counts as self-replication, why 'simplified', what 8 of 9 hardware types means, what is projection vs measured) let the writer attribute claims and keep a calm tone. Leads the issue as the strongest story.

research.why: Single preprint with one clear finding; the run-in labels (found / how it works / why it matters / uncertain, including 'not yet peer-reviewed') fit. Explainer used once only, in this slot.

invention.why: Plimsoll's value is clearest against alternatives (process, container, kernel, VM isolation, and ordinary sandboxes that run weaker if needed). Table keeps it concrete and leaves room for the young-project caveat.
